answer.finalSql:
SELECT SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS "covid_deaths"
FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a"
WHERE YEAR("date") = YEAR((SELECT MAX("date") FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a")) - 1
answer.assistantText: This totals new COVID deaths across all US states and counties for the last full calendar year in the US deaths dataset, which is the year before the year of the latest date in the data. I used the US dataset because no place was named; if you meant worldwide deaths, I can run that instead.
